status: Status: frozen (ADR-0119). Assigned values are immutable; a 'reserved...' construction may be filled once.
rules: Every label is printable ASCII, unique across the whole registry and never reused, including after retirement. A label names exactly one use (signature, hash, KDF, MAC or AEAD associated data) of exactly one object or construction.

New labels follow the pattern OM-<NAME>-<USE>-v<N>. The two 'documented' labels in lower-case style are copied verbatim from RECOVERY_AND_BACKUP_POLICY.md §10.2 and keep their spelling unless an ADR changes that document.

DS-SIG(label, crypto_profile, role, signer, body) = the canonical OM-CBOR encoding of the 5-element array [label: tstr, crypto_profile: uint, role: uint, signer: bstr, body: bstr]. The signature algorithm signs these bytes.
DS-HASH(label, body) = the canonical OM-CBOR encoding of the 2-element array [label: tstr, body: bstr]. Digest = {0: hash_alg, 1: H(DS-HASH(...))}. For hash_alg 1, H = SHA-256.
Both constructions carry the label as a CBOR text string whose header encodes its length, so no label is a prefix-collision of another input.
KDF/MAC/AEAD labels marked 'reserved' are allocated so that no other use can take them; their exact input construction is fixed by the CryptoProfile ADR that closes V-001.

constructions.DS-SIG: [label: tstr, crypto_profile: uint, role: uint, signer: bstr, body: bstr]

labels.label: OM-PREKEY-BUNDLE-SIG-v1
labels.construction: DS-SIG over canonical AsyncKeyBundle v1 body; fetcher authorizes signer through relationship-pinned ACS -> DeviceCredential and applies ADR-0140 generation freshness checks

labels.label: OM-PREKEY-SIG-v1
labels.construction: DS-SIG; for one-time kinds body = OM-CBOR [1, subject_device_id, crypto_profile, bundle_generation, provider_pool_id, kind, key_id, public_key] (ADR-0140)

labels.label: OM-PREKEY-GENERATION-CORE-v1
labels.construction: DS-HASH over OM-CBOR [DeviceID, CryptoProfile, generation, signed_prekey, pq_signed_prekey, pq_last_resort_prekey-or-null] (ADR-0140)

labels.label: OM-RECOVERY-RECORD-LOCATOR-v1
labels.object: opaque RecoveryStore index for encrypted RecoveryRecord (ADR-0138)

labels.label: om/recovery-root/v1
labels.construction: WebAuthn PRF salt input: label || epoch (RECOVERY_AND_BACKUP_POLICY.md §10.2)

labels.label: OM-RECOVERY-PROVIDER-METADATA-KEY-v1
labels.construction: HKDF-SHA256 from RecoveryRoot; info = label || recovery_scope_id; output 32 bytes
labels.object: provider-metadata recovery key for RecoveryRecord v1 (ADR-0141)

labels.label: OM-RECOVERY-RELATIONSHIP-SNAPSHOT-KEY-v1
labels.construction: normal profile: HKDF-SHA256 from RecoveryRoot, info = label || recovery_scope_id, output 32 bytes; Maximum Privacy may instead use an independent RelationshipRecoveryKey not derived from/wrapped by RecoveryRoot

labels.label: OM-RECOVERY-RECORD-AEAD-AD-v1
labels.object: AEAD associated data for encrypted RecoveryRecord v1 (ADR-0141)

labels.label: OM-Crypto-v1_PQXDH_X25519_SHA-256_ML-KEM-768
labels.construction: PQXDH 'info' parameter (Signal PQXDH rev 3 §2.1/§2.2) for OM-Crypto-v1; KDF(KM) = HKDF-SHA256(salt 0^32, IKM 0xFF^32 || KM, info = this label) (ADR-0135 §4)

labels.label: OM-1TO1-RATCHET-KDF-v1
labels.construction: Double Ratchet KDF_RK info: HKDF-SHA256(salt = rk, ikm = DH output, info = this label, 64 bytes); KDF_CK uses DR §5.2 HMAC constants and no label (ADR-0135 §4)

labels.label: OM-1TO1-EVENT-AEAD-AD-v1
labels.construction: AES-256-GCM-SIV associated data = OM-CBOR [this label, crypto_profile, session_AD, header_hash, envelope_context] (ADR-0135 §4)

labels.label: OM-SAFETY-REF-v1
labels.status: superseded: unused; raw concatenation is ambiguous (ADR-0128 rule 19)

labels.label: OM-SAFETY-REF-v2
labels.construction: DS-HASH over the canonical CBOR array [issuer_scope_id, principal_ref]

labels.object: Double Ratchet header (input to OM-DR-AEAD-NONCE-v1 and the AEAD associated data)
